Pranker's Pumpkin:
Pranker's Pumpkin
Uncommon Tool
Soulbound
Use: Throw it at another visible player within 15 yards. Their head becomes a glowing jack-o'-lantern for 30 seconds, and they can right-click it off. Neither of you can be in combat, and you cannot be stealthed. Never consumed: usable again after 60 seconds. Kept permanently and usable year-round. Cosmetic.
Wanderwisp Lantern:
Wanderwisp Lantern
Uncommon Tool
Soulbound
Use: Set the lantern down in front of you. A small ghost circles you for 60 seconds. Not usable in combat or while stealthed. Never consumed: usable again after 120 seconds. Kept permanently and usable year-round. Cosmetic.
Sack of Startled Bats:
Sack of Startled Bats
Uncommon Tool
Soulbound
Use: Open the sack. A squeaking swarm of bats bursts out and scatters around you for 6 seconds. Not usable in combat or while stealthed. Never consumed: usable again after 30 seconds. Kept permanently and usable year-round. Cosmetic.
Murmurwick Candle:
Murmurwick Candle
Uncommon Tool
Soulbound
Use: Light the candle in front of you. For 30 seconds its flames throw dancing shadows of a cat, a bat and a witch onto the ground around it, for everyone nearby to see. Not usable in combat or while stealthed. Never consumed: usable again after 90 seconds. Kept permanently and usable year-round. Cosmetic.
Gurglegreen Cauldron:
Gurglegreen Cauldron
Uncommon Tool
Soulbound
Use: Set a big bubbling cauldron down in front of you. It stands for 60 seconds, and any player who drinks from it bursts in green bubbles and turns into a goblin for 45 seconds, replacing any costume they wear. Neither setting it down nor drinking works in combat or while stealthed, and entering combat ends the goblin form. Never consumed: usable again after 120 seconds. Kept permanently and usable year-round. Cosmetic.
